what: a geometer's tools on a dark slate tablet, seen close and a little from above: a pair of large brass drawing dividers, two long straight polished brass legs hinged together at the top with a round brass knob, standing opened in a narrow upside-down V, their two steel points resting on the slate; on the black slate, drawn in bold white chalk, one big circle with a large triangle inside it whose three corners touch the circle, and nothing else on the slate. colours: Polished brass dividers with bright highlights and steel points; a black slate tablet in a dark wooden frame; bold white chalk lines.
must_show: brass dividers standing open on the slate
a chalk circle with a triangle inside
bright lines and brass against dark slate

what: an old globe of the world on a dark wooden stand with a polished brass ring round it, seen close, filling most of the picture; its seas are deep blue and its lands painted in sandy brown and dull green like an old map, with no writing anywhere on it. must_show: a globe of the world on a stand
a brass ring round it
lit globe against a dark background

what: the ruins of an ancient Greek temple at sunset, seen close from below: three tall fluted white marble columns still standing side by side, carrying one broken block of stone beam across their tops, and fallen drums of columns lying at their feet; they fill most of the picture. colours: Weathered white marble in shadow, warm grey with gold edges; a huge pale gold sun; a deep orange and red evening sky.
must_show: three standing ruined marble columns
a broken beam across their tops
dark columns against a bright sunset

what: a great red deer stag, a real animal on four legs, standing in a forest clearing at dawn, seen from the side and a little from the front so all four of its legs can be seen, its head turned toward the viewer, with huge branching antlers spreading wide above its head; it fills most of the picture. colours: A dark red-brown stag with a darker brown neck mane and a pale cream rump, pale bone-brown antlers; pale golden mist; dark tree trunks.

four legs
dark stag against pale mist

steam rising
bright fire and pot against a dark hearth

what: a round glass flask with a long neck standing on a brass tripod over a small blue flame, full of a glowing bright green liquid that bubbles, a curl of pale vapour rising from its neck; the flask is large in the middle of the picture. glowing bubbling green liquid
bright flask against a dark room

what: a little owl, the small owl of Athena, perched on top of a broken white marble column, seen close and facing the viewer: a flat round face disc with both big round yellow eyes forward, small ear tufts, brown feathers spotted with white; it is large in the middle of the picture. a marble column top under it
owl lit against a dark sky

what: a blacksmith's anvil in a dark forge, seen close: a heavy black iron anvil fills the lower middle of the picture, and lying across its top is a large quill pen glowing red-hot orange like iron fresh from the forge, yellow-white at its hottest; a few bright sparks fly up from it. A heavy smith's hammer with a wooden handle leans against the anvil. The glowing quill is the brightest thing in the picture; behind, the forge is near black with a dim red glow.
colours: A black iron anvil with pale grey worn edges; a quill glowing orange, yellow-white at its hottest; bright sparks; a dark iron hammer with a brown wooden handle; near-black forge with a dim red glow.
must_show: an iron anvil
a red-hot glowing quill pen lying on it
a smith's hammer
glowing quill against dark

what: a merchant's brass balance scale on a dark wooden counting table, seen close: a short upright brass post with a level beam across its top, and a round brass pan hanging from each end of the beam on three chains. colours: Polished brass scale with bright highlights; plain gold coins; a golden-brown crusty loaf; dark wooden table; deep brown shadow behind.
must_show: a brass balance scale with two hanging pans
gold coins in one pan
a loaf of bread in the other
beam level

what: the inside of a dark, ancient, plain stone sanctuary, seen close: one broad shaft of bright gold-white light falls from a high opening above, slanting down onto a plain square stone altar in the middle of the picture, on which a small clay oil lamp burns with a little flame; dust glitters in the beam. a plain stone altar in the light
a small burning lamp
bright beam against a dark sanctuary

colours: Deep royal blue enamel; bright gold bands, stand and knob; small white pearls; a dark red velvet cushion; deep brown shadow behind.
must_show: a jewelled egg of blue enamel and gold
a gold stand on a velvet cushion
bright egg against a dark background
